definitions.explanation: Traditional practices or behaviors passed down in a community or society.

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風習|ふうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。

notes:
{風習|ふうしゅう} refers to customs and traditional practices that have been passed down within a community or region over time. It emphasizes the social and cultural nature of the practice rather than individual habit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風習|ふうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow customs
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{風習|ふうしゅう}: old customs
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風習|ふうしゅう}: local customs
- {風習|ふうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: customs remain/survive
- {風習|ふうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{廃|すた}れる→廃れる：12426_sutareru⟧: customs die out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit or custom (can be personal or social)
- ⟦{慣習|かんしゅう}→慣習：05523_kanshuu⟧: convention, established practice (more formal/institutional)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧: tradition (broader, emphasizes continuity and value)
- ⟦{風俗|ふうぞく}→風俗：14694_fuuzoku⟧: manners and customs (often refers to the general customs of a time or place; also has a modern meaning of adult entertainment industry)

{風習|ふうしゅう} is most natural when talking about specific regional or cultural practices, such as seasonal festivals, wedding ceremonies, or local rituals.
